title: ALPSbox: one-click DTI-ALPS processing with quality control and HTML reports
description: ALPSbox computes the DTI-ALPS index from diffusion MRI per subject or for a cohort, on top of FSL and MRtrix3: Gibbs unringing, eddy-current/motion correction with outlier-slice replacement, brain extraction, tensor fitting and reorientation with vecreg, JHU-ICBM-FA-1mm registration, ROI extraction and the ALPS index. Each subject receives eight categories of quality-control checks (including a registration-robustness metric), a recorded processing definition and a single-file HTML report; CSV/JSON exports are provided for downstream statistics. GUI and CLI are bilingual (English/Chinese). The bundled ROI masks are reproduced from the MIT-licensed gbarisano/alps reference implementation; FSL and MRtrix3 are not redistributed. See the repository documentation for installation, validation and citations.
notes: Cite also the ALPS method paper (Taoka et al., 2017) and the reference implementation (gbarisano/alps, MIT) with its companion paper (Liu & Barisano, 2024). Full citations are in docs/CITATIONS.md and CITATION.cff.
